⏳ 5 DAYS AWAY: volunteers needed for the Park Parthenia Community Health Fair! 🙌
📅 Tue, Oct 6 · 1:00–4:30 PM
📍 Park Parthenia Apartments, 19100 Parthenia St., Northridge

Help run the tables, lead the kids' waste-sorting game, hand out kitchen pails and talk with residents about recycling ♻️
🗣️ ¿Hablas español? ¡Te necesitamos!

👉 Sign up at the link in bio! Swipe to see last year's fair.

#CSUN #ParkParthenia #CommunityHealthFair #VolunteersNeeded #Volunteer #Northridge #SanFernandoValley #RecyKOOL #ZeroWaste #CitizenScience

🌬️ CS majors: want your code to help people breathe easier?

Woniya Wichoni ("breath of life") is an ARCS air quality citizen science project focused on environmental data and Indigenous community health, centering community, land, and climate justice. 🌎

We're looking for students with:
💻 Programming (JavaScript or similar)
🗄️ Database systems
🌐 Front-end & back-end web development
🔀 Git/GitHub
🔌 Embedded systems

👉 Apply at the link in bio!
❓ Questions: citizen.science.csun@gmail.com

In partnership with ARCS, the CSUN Citizen Science Club & NASA JPL

#CSUN #ComputerScience #CitizenScience #AirQuality #ClimateJustice #EnvironmentalJustice #IndigenousHealth #NASAJPL #STEM #CSMajors #WebDevelopment #EmbeddedSystems #Matadors
